data.name: Discovery_OverrideToggle
data.comment: Checkbox label for the global discovery mode, shared by the Settings discovery section and the discovery escape-hatch. When checked, Curator uses the entered paths as-is and skips automatic Steam/Darktide detection; when unchecked, it rediscovers automatically.

data.value: When on, Curator uses these paths as-is and skips automatic detection. Turn off to rediscover Steam, Darktide, and Proton automatically.

data.name: Discovery_DiscoverButton
data.comment: The Discover button shared by the Settings discovery section and the discovery escape-hatch. Forces a fresh automatic discovery pass regardless of the current mode and refreshes the displayed paths.

data.name: EscapeHatch_Title
data.comment: Title of the discovery escape-hatch dialog shown on a DiscoveryIncomplete launch.

data.name: EscapeHatch_Header
data.value: We couldn't automatically discover everything needed to launch. Please help configure these paths.
data.comment: The friendly header of the escape-hatch dialog (NOT framed as an error).

data.name: EscapeHatch_SubmitButton
data.comment: The Submit button on the escape-hatch dialog (writes the entered paths + closes).

data.name: EscapeHatch_CancelButton
data.comment: The Cancel button on the escape-hatch dialog.

data.name: EscapeHatch_RetryHint
data.value: Click Launch to retry after updating.
data.comment: Note on the escape-hatch dialog telling the user to click Launch again after submitting (no auto-retry).

data.name: Launch_ErrorTitle
data.comment: Title of the modal alert shown when a launch returns LaunchStatus.Error.

data.name: Launch_StagingFailedTitle
data.comment: Title of the modal alert shown when a launch returns LaunchStatus.StagingFailed (a staging link could not be created).

data.name: Launch_StagingFailedMessage
data.value: Curator couldn't create the staging links for this profile. Check that Curator has write access to the profile's folder, and on Windows that the folder is on an NTFS volume (staging links require NTFS).
data.comment: Localized framing + actionable hint for the StagingFailed alert body. The raised exception's body (a runtime/OS error) is appended after this at the call site, so this reads as a lead-in to the detail.

data.name: GameDir_Title
data.comment: Title of the game-dir conflict modal (and its follow-up notice) shown when a launch finds a foreign entry at the game directory's mods slot.

data.name: GameDir_Message
data.value: Found an existing mods folder in the Darktide game directory. Curator needs to rename it to continue (or you can cancel and take care of the folder).
data.comment: Body of the game-dir conflict modal; asks whether to rename the foreign mods folder aside so Curator can deploy mods there.

data.name: GameDir_MessageFootnote
data.value: * If you previously patched Darktide make sure to unpatch it or run verify integrity of game files in Steam.
data.comment: Small-print advisory under the game-dir conflict modal body, for setups where the game itself was patched by an older modding method.

data.name: GameDir_CancelButton
data.comment: The Cancel button in the game-dir conflict modal. Aborts the launch; no game-dir mutation.

data.name: GameDir_RenameButton
data.comment: The Rename (accent) button in the game-dir conflict modal. Renames the foreign entry aside (nothing deleted, receipt + best-effort README recorded) and retries the launch once, now hosted.

data.name: GameDir_RenamedNotice
data.value: Renamed the existing mods folder to {0}.
data.comment: One-line alert shown after a successful takeover, before the launch retry. {0} is the renamed folder's path returned by the takeover.

data.name: GameDir_StillConflicts
data.value: The game's mods folder is still occupied by something Curator didn't create: {0}
data.comment: Body of the error alert shown when a game-dir conflict recurs in the same launch attempt (the retry is one-shot per consent). {0} is the detected path.

data.name: GameDir_TakeOverFailed
data.value: Curator couldn't move the existing mods folder aside.
data.comment: Localized framing for the alert shown when the consented takeover fails. The exception's message is appended after this at the call site.

data.name: Launch_OverlayTitle
data.comment: Title on the centered progress card of the full-client launch overlay, shown while a launch attempt is in progress.

data.name: Launch_OverlayMessage
data.comment: Message under the launch overlay title (a real ellipsis character, matching the repo localization style). The overlay blocks the client area until Darktide is detected or the bounded wait times out.

data.name: Welcome_Title
data.comment: Title of the first-run Welcome window.

data.name: Welcome_Intro
data.value:
Curator works without a Nexus connection, but connecting Nexus enables its most useful online features.
Set up Nexus to check your installed mods for updates and enable download links on NexusMods.com that send mods directly to Curator. Nexus Premium members can also install updates from within the app.
data.comment: Intro in the Welcome window. Explains why Nexus setup is useful while making clear that it is optional.

data.name: Welcome_CapabilityProfiles
data.value: Connect using Nexus sign-in or an API key
data.comment: Bullet: the two supported ways to connect Curator to Nexus.

data.name: Welcome_CapabilityUpdates
data.value: Enable Nexus download links so manager downloads open in Curator
data.comment: Bullet: the Nexus download-link setting available in Integrations.

data.name: Welcome_CapabilityNxm
data.value: Change these options at any time from Integrations
data.comment: Bullet: reassures the user that onboarding choices are not permanent.

data.name: Welcome_SetUpNexus
data.comment: Accent primary button label. Opens the Integrations dialog after Welcome closes.

data.name: Welcome_Continue
data.comment: Secondary button label. Skips Nexus setup; leaves the user at the main window.
